item.title: Make listItems follow cursor pagination
item.brief:
Implement the client side of the shared contract in this repository. listItems(transport) must return every item in order by following next_cursor until it is null or absent, passing the cursor back unchanged; the first request sends no cursor. Add tests with a fake transport that serves multiple pages, a single page, and a missing next_cursor. Update the README to document that listItems pages through all results. Make sure npm test passes. Commit the change.

item.title: Add cursor pagination to GET /items
item.brief: Implement the API side of the shared contract in this repository. Add optional limit (1..100, default 20) and cursor query params to GET /items, ordered by id, returning {"items": [...], "next_cursor": ...} with next_cursor null on the last page. Return 400 with {"error": "..."} for an invalid limit or cursor. Add unit tests covering paging, last page, default limit, and invalid inputs. Update the README to document the new parameters and response shape. Make sure python3 -m unittest passes. Commit the change.

pr.body: Approach: api.py list_items parses limit and cursor (keyset on id: cursor is the last id of the previous page; items with a greater id are returned). Invalid limit or cursor returns 400 with an error body. Digit strings longer than 18 characters are rejected before int() to avoid a crash on very long input. Files: api.py, test_api.py, README.md. Checks: python3 -B -m unittest (11 tests, OK). Review: three whole-change reviews failed on the overlong-digit crash; fixed in commit 6a43369; delta reviews of 75843ad..6a43369 pass. Follow-ups (non-blocking): get_item still calls int() after isdigit() (pre-existing, same crash class for very long or superscript ids); the 18-digit cap is not documented in README; list-valued or non-string query values raise AttributeError (outside the str-to-str contract); list_items re-sorts ITEMS per request; default page size of 20 is a breaking change for callers that expect every item (migration note suggested).
pr.summary: made GET /items paged. now can pass limit (1..100, default 20) and cursor; next_cursor null on last page. before: all 57 items in one body, now: first 20 items plus next_cursor.
